title: Day-of Rapid Tour — Booth Expense & Contact Playbook
content:
Purpose: super-compact reference for day-of logistics, quick receipts, who-to-call, and reimbursement steps for the single-day customer pilot tour. Use this as a pocket playbook — keep on phone.

Top-level timeline (day-of):
- 06:15 — Load-in (crew meet at loading dock B). Bring 2 carts + blue tie-down straps.
- 07:00 — AV tech arrival window (see contact list). Run mic check + streamer test by 07:30.
- 08:30 — Booth open (staff rotation schedule below).
- 12:00 — Lunch quick-service window (catering drop; veg counts confirmed by Rina).
- 16:00 — End-of-day teardown begins (pack posters first, then demo laptops).

Quick staff rotation (names):
- 08:30–11:00: Asha / Diego
- 11:00–13:30: Rina / L. Chen (float)
- 13:30–16:00: Diego / L. Chen
- Teardown crew: Asha + 2 temps (orderly pack list below)

Expense rules (short):
- Card use: use company Amex for any vendor >$10. If vendor insists on cash, get itemized receipt + note reason.
- Meals: per-diem $65/day (NYC rate). Full receipts required for reimbursement above $25.
- Taxis/rides: Lyft/Uber recommended; save trip receipts/export PDF from app.
- Shipping: pre-approved FedEx account (acct 54-REDWOOD-OPS). For ad-hoc shipping, take photos of waybill and hand receipt.
- Tips: meal/service tips up to 20% reimbursable with receipt.
- Misc small buys (<$25): annotate on receipt "event-supply" and consolidate in one claim.

Receipts / submission notes:
- Naming convention for uploads: RR-YYYYMMDD-<VENDOR>-<AMOUNT> (e.g., RR-20250618-FEDEx-42.80).
- Expense tool: Expensify. Tag claim with project code: ENG-TOUR-23.
- Submit within 5 business days of event. If missing receipt, file lost-receipt form (attach photo + short justification).
- Slack evidence: drop a photo of receipt in #events-expenses and ping Rina for quick verification before submission.

Packing / booth teardown priority (order matters):
1) Demo laptops (labelled), power bricks into the small black bag
2) Demo router + ethernet snake (place in padded box)
3) Handouts and printed posters (roll posters, protect edges)
4) Banner hardware and stands (loose items in orange bin)
5) Giveaway swag (count and note leftover qty)
6) Tablecloth / logo cloth (fold, place on top of soft items)

Vendor contacts (call in this order for issues):
- AV / On-site tech: SoundWave Events — Priya Nair (mobile) +1-415-555-0172 — confirm mic & HDMI routing.
- Internet / local wifi rental: QuickMesh Rentals — support +1-415-555-0199 (acct: RW-EXH-1).
- Catering quick-service drop: NoshNow — manager Hugo Park +1-415-555-0134 (confirm veg numbers by 7:00am).
- Freight / extra cart rental: CityMover Logistics — ops +1-415-555-0110 (ask for Mark, ID: CM-183).
- Same-day printing (last-minute badges/handouts): PrintFast — +1-415-555-0127 (on-site pickup).
- Shipping/Freight inbound questions: FedEx location (Pier 3) +1-415-555-0148 (reference acct 54-REDWOOD-OPS).

On-call emergency contacts (Redwood internal):
- Ops lead (Rina Patel) — mobile +1-650-555-0234 — primary
- Security liaison (Marcus Li) — mobile +1-650-555-0301 — secondary
- Finance quick-approve (Diego Morales) — mobile +1-650-555-0412 — for urgent card overrides

Booth petty cash & vendor wallet rules:
- We carry a $100 petty envelope for small cash-only vendors. Sign-out sheet required (initials + purpose + amount).
- For vendor pre-pay (e.g., local taxis), capture receipt and log in envelope; Rina to reconcile at EOD.

Common gotchas / notes to self:
- Bring the 3-port USB-C hub + ethernet adapter (we forgot last time — burned 20m).
- Confirm demo laptop sleep settings: disable auto-lock, set screen brightness to 80% to save battery but keep look crisp.
- Speaker gift: put sticker in top drawer of orange bin and hand over after talk.
- If AV says "backup mic" is not available, escalate to SoundWave manager immediately (Priya).
- Photo proof for freebies: take one photo of swag table before first giveaway.

Unresolved questions (to follow up in post-mortem):
- Can we source extra labeled tote bags for staff (cost code: MERCH-OPS)?
- Should we move to cashless-only for next single-day run to minimize petty reconciliation?
- Confirm whether catering invoice can be directed to AP with PO ENG-23-007 (Diego to confirm).

Post-event EOD checklist (submit within 24h when possible):
- Upload all receipts to Expensify + tag ENG-TOUR-23
- Send final headcount + leftover swag qty to ops channel (#events-exhibits)
- Quick notes: what failed / what saved us (2–3 bullets)
- Confirm return shipping label placed on demo crate and email tracking to logistics@redwood.ai

Last-minute tips:
- Keep the waterproof envelope for passports and cash in the top right of orange bin.
- Battery bank + 1 lightning cable in the staff pouch.
- If parking validation is unclear, get a photo of the pay station and note location code for finance.

End — keep this doc as your pocket reference. Update after event (I will add EOD notes and reconciliation status).
